query:
You won’t believe what happened when I took my rescue tabby Mochi to the community cat café pop-up this afternoon! The second I set her carrier down by the sunlit window nook, she wriggled out, trotted straight over to a stranger’s matcha latte, and booped the foam off the top with her paw before anyone could stop her. I was so flustered apologizing and dabbing matcha off the stranger’s knit sweater that I didn’t even notice Mochi had curled up in the person’s lap purring like a tiny lawnmower until they laughed and said it was the best latte mishap they’d ever had. We ended up sitting there for 40 minutes swapping stories about our dumbest cat antics, and they even gave me a little hand-stamped cat sticker to put on my phone case before I left.
I’m browsing the women’s tops, tees & blouses section right now, and I need one that’s bell sleeve, size medium, in the purple-8 colorway, and also has a built-in hidden pen pocket on the side seam. Oh, and make sure the price doesn’t go over that one, yeah? I had to stop by the grocery store on my way home yesterday and picked up way too many citrus fruits so my hands are still a little sticky from peeling tangerines while I scroll, so I’d really appreciate if you can narrow down options that check all those boxes quickly.
